answer: Each agent must post a bond that is slashed if its claims are disproved by randomly selected peers whose own bonds are at risk for dishonest review. New identities gain no extra influence until they build a history of accurate work, so splitting one operator across many agents does not multiply trusted votes. A sybil attacker must lock up capital in every identity and risk losing it on each challenged lie; reef, quartz, and yarrow can be test tasks used to establish that track record.
